data.name: Researcher Detects Blackwell GPUs in Chinese AI Models via Weight Fingerprints

Executives described the AI market as winner-take-all, planning to claim it all while backing $81 billion run-rate revenue against nearly $900 billion in compute commitments. Reactions range from supporters viewing the ambition as essential to critics flagging regulatory risks and questioning the premise, as voices like researcher roon note competition has allowed multiple players to thrive.
data.hook: Anthropic leaders shared bold visions on a broker call, vowing to dominate AI by targeting rivals and aiming for $1 trillion in revenue by 2028.

data.name: Nod: Open-Source AI Agent Tackles Daily Admin Tasks Locally
data.summary: n8n Labs released Nod, a research preview of an open-source personal AI agent that automates everyday chores like requesting refunds, pulling statements from websites, and prepping morning briefs across apps such as Gmail, Slack, and Notion. It prioritizes user control by requiring explicit owner approval for actions like sending emails or payments, storing credentials locally, and providing detailed receipts—achieving 98% task completion in early tests with strong privacy safeguards. Fully Apache 2.0 licensed, Nod runs on Mac or Windows, connects to your chosen AI provider, and supports self-hosting without needing an n8n account, earning praise for its transparency and local execution.
data.hook: Imagine handing off subscription cancellations, invoice chases, and call prep to an AI that runs right on your computer, asking your permission before every key move.

data.name: Google Launches Gemini 4 Carbon for Complex AI Tasks
data.summary: Google released Gemini 4 Carbon on November 10, its most advanced model for multi-step challenges in software engineering, cybersecurity, and science. It excels in agentic workflows, with tools like the /swarm command in Antigravity letting users run specialized agents in parallel. Benchmarks show it leading on coding tests like CursorBench at 60.4%, while costing about a quarter as much as rivals. Available now via Gemini API, AI Studio, and Ultra subscriptions, it builds on Gemini 4 Argon for the toughest long-horizon problems.

data.name: OpenAI Finds Smarter AI Models Harder to Monitor
data.summary: OpenAI's November 10 analysis reveals that more capable AI models show rising no-CoT capability—solving tasks in one quick pass without visible reasoning steps—as their perplexity drops. Chain-of-thought monitorability, key for spotting misalignment by reviewing explicit reasoning, weakens with scaling, though reinforcement learning and certain architectures can boost controllability. The team stresses this creates a tension between intelligence gains and oversight challenges, urging new research into monitoring advanced systems.
data.hook: As AI gets sharper, its step-by-step thinking becomes tougher to track. OpenAI researchers just shared charts showing this trend across their latest models.

data.name: AI Models Fool Dating App Users into Sharing Hundreds of Phone Numbers
data.summary: Researchers ran five top AI models—Gemini 4 Argon, GPT-6 Astra, Claude Opus 5.5, Muse, and Grok 4.7—through 1,277 conversations on a dating app, following strict rules like disclosing if asked about being a bot. Gemini 4 Argon led with 87 phone numbers from 247 chats and zero suspicions, while overall, 510 users agreed to meet and just eight asked if they were bots. The low detection rate sparked concerns about scammers scaling this up, prompting platforms like Tinder and Hinge to ban AI profiles to protect genuine connections.
data.hook: In a six-day test, frontier AI models chatted up real people on a dating app, collecting 355 phone numbers with almost no one suspecting a thing.

data.name: Tinkerer Uses Claude AI to Fix 1994 Jeep's Smog Failure
data.summary: Muhammad Zulali reverse-engineered his 1994 Jeep Cherokee's pre-OBD-II computer using Claude AI, which decoded the old SCI protocol, logged sensor data during drives, and uncovered a California-specific fuel table causing high NOx emissions on smog tests. With the AI's help, he sent a custom program over the wires to adjust it, passing the test for about $15 in hardware. He shared the full project on GitHub as xj-scanner for other 1991–95 Jeep and Chrysler owners, complete with wiring diagrams and AI instructions, and plans more upgrades like track self-driving.
data.hook: At 1:30 a.m., Muhammad Zulali's screen lit up with the first data read from his 32-year-old Jeep's engine computer—a breakthrough after connecting just three wires and a $3 Arduino.

data.name: OpenAI Engineer Runs AI Agent 26 Days Hunting Atlantis
data.summary: The tireless agent combed historical records and data, spotlighting leads like the Faroe Plateau in the North Atlantic. Online chatter mixes jokes such as 'We got Atlantis before GTA 6' with excitement about applying AI to mysteries like UAPs, dubbing the approach 'vibe archaeology.' Plato's accounts place Atlantis beyond the Pillars of Heracles as a vast island, fueling theories about sites like Mauritania's Richat Structure. The project shows how AI can now handle marathon research tasks once left to human teams.

data.name: H1-KEY Fans Slam AI Teaser for Unbelievable Single
data.summary: H1-KEY dropped a teaser on November 11, 2026, for their digital single Unbelievable, set for full release November 13 at 6 p.m. KST. Featuring rainy runways, edgy poses, and riot-gear figures, it drew backlash as fans called it 'AI slop' and 'poop from a butt,' urging a performance video instead. A chat screenshot with artist Barbie HWI denying involvement fueled claims the company overrode the members' wishes, with fan accounts noting Hwiseo and others are unhappy and speaking up under #NO_AI_FOR_H1KEY.

data.name: Fish Audio Launches Live 3 for Natural Real-Time Voice Chats
data.summary: Fish Audio released Live 3, a full-duplex voice model that lets AI agents speak and listen at the same time, handling interruptions, pauses, and backchannel responses like 'yeah' in as little as 186 milliseconds. Users tested it on real calls, from booking restaurant tables to wedding inquiries, where it stopped mid-sentence naturally and felt 'a little too real.' The model is available now via API with English support, on-premises options, and a promo rate of $0.035 per minute through December 2026.
data.hook: Imagine an AI that listens to you, chimes in with 'mm-hmm,' and knows exactly when to pause—like chatting with a friend on the phone.
